scope: Offline static qualification and evidence audit; registry unchanged; no GPU/physics runs; no selection based on outcomes.
qualification_limit: Native geometric dimensions are verified. Neither registration nor this CPU audit settles each object in physics; post-settle height>=8mm and pose stability remain unverified for the full40.
uniqueness_limit: Sorted hull distance spectra are rotation/translation/uniform-scale invariant screening, not a mathematical proof of noncongruence for all homometric point sets. Distinct sphere triangulations can differ despite equivalent analytic shape.

noise_audit.distribution: independent Gaussian N(0,std^2) per pixel/channel for each of six FingerEye RGB arrays
noise_audit.stream: single stream consumed in fixed finger_names order at each acquisition; no draws when std==0
noise_audit.recording: stage9_backend replaces recorder FingerEye frames with exact post-noise RGB; external view unchanged
noise_audit.caveat: Equal seed does not make clean/noisy trajectories or cross-process rendered pixels identical. Noise is pixel perturbation only, not camera blur/calibration/dropout.

three_finger_baseline_first_rejection.explanation: Endpoint failure precedes any command. Robot self overlap is independent of object-envelope uncertainty. Envelope collision is a conservative public-model check, not physical contact or private object mesh overlap.

three_finger_true_mesh_offline_counterfa.scope: Offline static candidate pose against true initial cube mesh; zero executed commands and no physical contact claim.
three_finger_true_mesh_offline_counterfa.limitation: Authored robot meshes and true initial object mesh; not simulator cooked convex pieces. Public-envelope overapproximation cannot excuse independent robot self overlap.
